statement: Three items from my treatment (§6 rows 8, 9, and the G1/G3 work-order row) are copy, not presentation, so I cannot place them. I need one decision on each. (c) The standing work order reads '[F] PRESENT THE SUIT RECORD.' / '[F] STOW THE BONDED CELL AND DEPART.' but touch input is 'USE'; the hint glyph is shipped, protected copy, so I will not restyle it into parity. statement: I accept all four constraints in your §6. No periodic luminance anywhere: every fitting in my plan is fixed-cardinality and static; fog and fill move only on threshold cross-fades, which are one-shot eases, never loops. The cross-fade stays a named constant: FILL_FADE_SECONDS becomes a per-district column of the fill table (concourse-open 1.4 s in, hall 1.0 s in, others at the shipped 0.8 s), still exported by name so a future bloom can anchor to it. The HUD entry flash is one-shot per objective id. No visualiser bars, no grille glow. Question: my per-threshold semantics ('warmth arrives slowly, cold arrives fast') are a tempo of a kind, even if aperiodic. Do you want those durations and their direction recorded now in the future station-audio packet so a concourse-open cue can be composed to land inside the 1.4 s window, or is a contract line naming the constant sufficient and the packet inherits it later?
requestedAction: Confirm acceptance is sufficient, and state whether the per-threshold fade durations should be written into the deferred station-audio packet now or only named in the contract.
